posts.text: Inter demat transfer , any time limit? — Yeah, if you’re transferring shares from the secondary demat to the primary demat, you’ll just need to add your primary demat account as a beneficiary from the secondary account. Basically, it’s the vice versa of what you did earlier when you added the secondary demat as a beneficiary. Other than that, the process remains the same.

posts.author: rihan_baji
posts.text: Inter demat transfer , any time limit? — Hi Sandeep, the timing is based on when the transfer is authorised using the CDSL TPIN. If you are authorising the transfer: Before 2 PM: CDSL sends the verification email and SMS by 5 PM on the same trading day. Between 2 PM and 3 PM: The verification email and SMS are sent on the next trading day. After 3 PM: The verification email and SMS are also sent on the next trading day. Once you receive the CDSL Email/SMS, the OTP verification needs to be completed before 8 PM on the same day. After successful verification, the shares are credited to the other…
